trip.name: May 2026 sit
trip.notes_markdown: Thermostat lives by the kitchen door — leave it at 70°F.

pets.name: Mango
pets.quirks_markdown: Loves the windowsill at sunrise. Will pretend the food bowl is empty when it isn't.

care.body_markdown: 1/3 cup dry food in the kitchen bowl. Fresh water.
1/2 can wet food, hallway dish. Hide if guests come over — that's normal.

pets.name: Pepper
pets.quirks_markdown: Senior cat — slower, deaf in one ear, very chatty.

care.body_markdown: 1/3 cup senior dry food, same bowl as Mango but Mango usually steals it. Watch them.
1/2 can wet food. She gets the laundry-room dish — closes the door so Mango can't bother her.

pets.name: Otis
pets.quirks_markdown: Big, friendly, will lean on you. Knows sit, down, leave it.

care.body_markdown: 1.5 cups kibble. 20-minute walk before breakfast — he's calmer after.
1.5 cups kibble. Last potty break by 10pm, otherwise he'll wake you at 5am.

pets.name: Juniper
pets.quirks_markdown: Tiny, anxious of strangers for the first day. Once she warms up, she's a velcro dog.

care.body_markdown: 1/2 cup kibble. Short walk with Otis, but watch — she gets dragged if he sees a squirrel.
1/2 cup kibble. Sleeps on a blanket at the foot of the bed if she's chosen you.

house_notes.title: Thermostat & lights
house_notes.body_markdown: Thermostat by the kitchen door, leave at 70°F. The front porch light is on a timer — don't touch the switch.

house_notes.title: Trash day
house_notes.body_markdown: Bins go out Tuesday night. Recycling is the blue bin, every other Tuesday.

house_notes.title: Vet — open 24/7
house_notes.body_markdown: Banfield Pet Hospital. (555) 123-4567. 2 miles south on Main. Pets' records are under the household name.

house_notes.title: Neighbor with spare key
house_notes.body_markdown: Diane next door at the gray house. (555) 987-6543. She's home most days.

house_notes.title: WiFi
house_notes.body_markdown: Network: HouseWifi · Password: purr-bark-purr-bark · 5G band is faster, 2.4G reaches the back porch.

morning_tasks.title: Feed Mango & Pepper
morning_tasks.description_markdown: Watch that Mango doesn't eat Pepper's food.

morning_tasks.title: Walk Otis (20 min)
morning_tasks.description_markdown: Leashes by the front door. Poop bags in the bowl.

morning_tasks.title: Quick walk for Juniper
morning_tasks.description_markdown: Around the block — she's small and tires fast.

morning_tasks.title: Refill water bowls
morning_tasks.description_markdown: Three bowls: kitchen, laundry, back porch.

night_tasks.title: Last walk for the dogs
night_tasks.description_markdown: By 10pm or Otis wakes you at 5.

night_tasks.title: Lock back door & set porch light
night_tasks.description_markdown: Porch light is on a timer — don't toggle the switch.
